working_geometry_plain: The working L4 geometry is a finite terrain/channel/generator family carried by PEPS3D spinor-density anchors. The scout keeps terrain laws, sheet, loop, placement token, and PEPS3D anchor distinct. It earns eight sheeted terrain generator laws and 16 sheet/loop/terrain placements with a loop/terrain order witness and local terrain-order entropy cuts. This is still a local finite layer lego, not operator substages, stacking, flux, Axis0, physics, or final manifold evidence.
finite_map: L4_TK : (K=(V,E,F,C), finite spinor densities rho_v, sheet s in {L,R}, loop ell in {in,out}, terrain tau in {Se,Ne,Ni,Si}, finite terrain channel X_(tau,s), finite paths Loop->Terrain and Terrain->Loop) -> finite terrain generator signatures, 16 placement signatures, loop/terrain order gaps, and local QIT entropy/cut readouts
